channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: A 403 you could have predicted
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A board refused a release announcement, the server had already computed the reason, and the API did not publish it. tsbb 0.5.1 returns canPost per forum and myna 0.16.0 reads it as the right viewer.

item.title: myna 0.15.0: myna update
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: myna 0.15.0 adds a self update command: it picks the right asset for the machine, verifies the published checksum, and renames the new binary over the running one.

item.title: myna 0.14.0: a login you can script, and forums that take turns
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: myna 0.14.0 takes login values as command line arguments for every network, and a tsbb board now picks several forums at login and cycles posts through them.

item.title: Remember Winamp? nixamp is the Napster part now
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: nixamp got a public stream directory, listen-only keys, x402 pay-to-listen past five listeners, RTMP in and out, and accounts that own a server.

item.title: watchnews.now: follow the desk, not the algorithm
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A news reader that shows what a newsroom actually published, built as a brand entry on an existing platform rather than a fork.

item.title: nixamp now runs in your terminal, your browser and your dock
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: nixamp is three surfaces on one engine now: the terminal player, an installable PWA, and an Electron app that carries the CLI inside it. Plus the two bugs that only showed up once there was a second way to run it.

item.title: A terminal UI you can write a test against
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: DiskPush's two-pane browser was 940 lines of hand-rolled ANSI. Rewriting it on HQTUI made the frame a value, and three bugs fell out that reading the code had missed.

item.title: Fifty tech CEOs, scored on what they gave away
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Series Six of opensourcelegends.com cards the people who ran the companies, rated on what those companies gave away. Plus the hardcoded crest that shipped the wrong set name onto all fifty card fronts.

item.title: We shipped 50 portraits of real people and every face was invented
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An AI trading card set shipped with 50 generated portraits. None of them were the actual person. What it took to fix it, and why 23 cards now have no face at all.

item.title: The gallery stopped making excuses
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: hqtui's widget gallery had holes in it and printed a reason under each one. The reason was wrong, so I closed the gap instead: all 28 widgets now reach all 11 languages, COBOL included.
